description: This file defines device-side assertion mechanisms for CUDA within the PyTorch c10 library, including functions for copying strings and recording assertion failures, as well as a macro for kernel assertions.

methods.name: dstrcpy
methods.description: Copies a string from source to destination within device code, ensuring it does not exceed maximum length.

methods.name: dsa_add_new_assertion_failure
methods.description: Records a new assertion failure in device assertions data, including failure details and thread/block identifiers.
